topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
response: On-board storage constraints limit data packet size for time-tagged services, affecting payload power allocation. Immediate services don't occupy on-board memory, while time-tagged services require storage, influencing power allocation to ensure sufficient capacity.
reference_context: SatCom systems face constraints like on-board storage and power limits, impacting service prioritization and payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged services.
